transcript.text: I need to flag a concern about the 700 kg platform. I received the stage engineer's revised floor-load map after the draft package circulated, and it shows the planned 700 kg platform cannot be concentrated on one area. The approved alternative is three separate platforms with load spreaders, each carrying no more than 400 kg. I haven't uploaded the revised map to the build packet yet, but this change needs to be incorporated before we proceed.

transcript.text: I have a concern about the red fabric backdrop. I confirmed with our fabric supplier this morning that the only available backdrop material with the required flame-retardant certification is 180 meters of Slate Gray FR-7. The red fabric called for in the draft package has no current certification, so we'll need to switch to the Slate Gray FR-7 to stay compliant. I'm still waiting on the purchase order before I can enter the confirmation in the materials log.

transcript.text: I have a concern about the west-side camera entrance. After blocking, I ran a camera test with the crane and found that it needs a clear west-to-east lane 2.4 meters wide. That means the scenic entrance needs to be on the east side, not the west side as called for in the current draft. This note is still in my camera report and hasn't been added to the scenic drawings yet, so it needs to be incorporated before we finalize the build package.

commitments.detail: Update the build package to specify three separate platforms with load spreaders, each carrying no more than 400 kg, replacing the single 700 kg platform.
Change the fabric backdrop from red fabric to 180 meters of Slate Gray FR-7 with flame-retardant certification.
Move the scenic entrance from the west side to the east side to accommodate a 2.4-meter west-to-east camera lane.
Upload the stage engineer's revised floor-load map to the build packet before construction begins.
Finalize the purchase order for the Slate Gray FR-7 fabric and enter the confirmation in the materials log.
Add the camera test findings to the scenic drawings so the east-side entrance is reflected in the final build package.
